summary: Post-cleanup for the sound system, called from Game_Post. Optionally writes a debug-log line gated on a string-split parse, issues a guarded virtual dispatch on an init-status global, clears a scene-camera parameter, then resets entries of a sound pointer table whose value lies in (0,291): one reset via a virtual slot on a global object and up to 20 resets over a stride-8 table. Returns the last reset outcome.

operations.description: Call StringSplitLoop(2, aDDevF119992002_24, 760) and proceed to the debug-log write only when its byte result is non-zero.
Write the entered-sound message aEnteredSoundPo into the debug buffer dword_8AD25C via DebugLogWrite when the parse guard passes.
Execute VirtualCallOnDAT008ac4c4, a virtual call on the init-status global.
Clear/zero the scene-camera parameter at flt_8AC4B0 via sub_4C7E80((int)&flt_8AC4B0).
Invoke GlobalVirtualDispatchGuarded, a guarded virtual dispatch on a global object.
If the global object dword_5EB10C is non-null and its vtable slot +8 (thiscall) returns non-zero, gate the next action on the value flt_5EA618[699] being greater than 0 and less than 291.
When all above guards pass, call the vtable slot +12 of dword_5EB10C (thiscall) to perform the reset.

Iterate 20 entries starting at flt_5EA618[537] with an 8-byte stride; for each entry whose first dword is greater than 0 and less than 291, call StructInitWithSentinelValues on it and store the result.
Return the value left by the final loop iteration (the last table entry's dword or the last StructInitWithSentinelValues result).

unresolved: Meaning of dword_5EB10C and of the two virtual slots (+8 check, +12 action) invoked on it.
Meaning and ownership of StructInitWithSentinelValues and the (0,291) validity window applied to table entries.
